## Summary

Describe the process or infrastructure change without including private trading information.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests or validation commands are listed
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration validates
- [ ] noVNC and Dashboard remain bound to `127.0.0.1`
- [ ] Paper-trading-only boundary is preserved

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No account number, HTS ID, customer information, API key, token, or password
- [ ] No real holdings, orders, fills, P&L, or screenshots containing them
- [ ] No private strategy rules or parameters
- [ ] Examples use synthetic identifiers and data
- [ ] Local `.env`, Hermes state, and Obsidian files are not committed

## Documentation

- [ ] Relevant ADR, runbook, or progress log is updated
